description: This file contains the implementation of a Promise class conforming to the Promises/A+ specification. It provides methods for handling asynchronous operations, including chaining, resolution, rejection, cancellation, and waiting on promise results. The class is part of the GuzzleHttpomise namespace and implements core promise behaviors used for managing asynchronous tasks in PHP.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: A class implementing the Promises/A+ specification to manage asynchronous operations, supporting chaining, resolution, rejection, cancellation, and waiting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Promise object with optional wait and cancel functions.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise, returning a new chained promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection handler to the promise, invoked if the promise is rejected.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is settled and returns the fulfillment value or throws if rejected.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise (pending, fulfilled, or rejected).

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise if it is pending, invoking the cancel function if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Fulfills the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.
